obfuscation_indicators: strategy will take time to develop
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, including backlog, impairment, pension obligations, and settlement losses. Risk tone is moderately negative due to COVID-19 effects, supply-chain disruption, reduced print demand, and a $750 million goodwill impairment, although management expresses confidence in recovery and strategic diversification. Long definitions, cross-references, and extensive strategic language increase complexity and modestly dilute the risk discussion.
